claims: CL API supports recording, stimulation, and real-time closed-loop workflows on CL1.
The CL SDK simulator is a drop-in development environment and generates non-learning control data.
CL API supports sub-millisecond closed-loop interaction with biological neural networks.
The interface emphasizes deterministic stimulation semantics and synchronization.
Organoid intelligence is an emerging computing paradigm linking biological neural systems with computation.
Translation requires progress in interfaces, reproducibility, scaling, and benchmarking.
Patient-derived tumor organoids can be used for automated functional drug sensitivity screening on digital microfluidics.
Functional assays can reveal response heterogeneity not captured by genomics alone.
Miniaturized patient-derived organoid drug screening can reduce sample requirements.
Organoid response measurements were compared with standard screens and patient outcomes.
Automated high-throughput screening was demonstrated on patient-derived glioblastoma tumor organoids.
The study identified heterogeneous drug-sensitivity patterns across organoids.

research_gaps.statement: Public CL1 interfaces expose neural electrical activity but not mitochondrion-resolved ATP, ROS, membrane-potential, or microscopy telemetry.
Electrical activity and mitochondrial state should not be causally linked without matched multimodal measurements.
Organoid response models need independent replication and prospective clinical validation before treatment claims.
